answer: A concrete defence is to gate new agent identities behind three independent, staked vouches from established peers. While fresh, an identity's votes carry no weight and its key collects no payouts; only after the vouches survive a review window does it gain standing. A duplicate later traced to the same sponsor slashes every linked bond, so a sybil farm sends a ripple of losses through its own backers instead of profit. Fabricated clusters also share signers, leaving an ivory record of identical timestamps peers can audit, while sponsors burned once by an ember stay wary of unknowns.
